conditions.note: Datasets were written by the project author. Routing rules and the abstention threshold were revised once after the baseline run (baseline_v1.json) using the dev sets, so dev-set scores are optimistic; held-out sets (routing_heldout, unanswerable_heldout) were written before those changes and never used for tuning.

routing.method: Supervisor's top intent (full LangGraph run via API) compared with the labelled intent. Items marked memory=true first establish ORD-1002 in the same conversation.

heldout.note: Written after the baseline run and before rule fixes; never used for tuning.

tool_selection.method: The set of tools actually executed during the turn (from the execution trace) must equal the labelled set.

task_completion.method: Scripted multi-turn scenarios (including admin approve/reject) checked against response content, citations, memory flags and resulting database rows.

retrieval.method: Fraction of the top-5 retrieved chunks whose policy section is labelled relevant. Each query has only 1-2 relevant sections, so the attainable ceiling is reported alongside the score.

groundedness.abstention_definition: Response contains no policy/product claim: the knowledge agent's 'couldn't find that' or the product agent's 'couldn't find products matching'.
groundedness.method: Scored only on turns answered by the knowledge agent with citations (answered_rate shows how many policy questions reached it; the rest were routed elsewhere). An answer sentence is 'supported' when >=80% of its content tokens appear in one cited chunk. In deterministic mode answers are extractive, so high support is expected by construction; the more informative numbers are relevant_citation_rate and abstention accuracy on unanswerable questions.
groundedness.llm_judge: Not Evaluated: LLM-as-judge groundedness requires an LLM API key, which was not configured for this run.

latency.method: Every POST /api/chat issued during this evaluation, measured in-process (FastAPI TestClient, no network hop). graph_ms = LangGraph execution; api_ms = full request including auth and persistence.
